extracted.summary: A programme aimed at providing financial support to students in South India for higher education after high school.
extracted.amount_text: Scholarships from INR 10,000 to INR 1,00,000, with funds sent directly to the educational institution to cover tuition and related costs.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have passed the 12th board or Pre-University Course (PUC) examination with a minimum of 60% marks.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be a resident of Karnataka, Kerala or Tamil Nadu.
